title: Per-leaf verdict
description: Single leaf grading record. Matches SimpleJudge's per-leaf semantics: score is 0 or 1 for standard leaves; 0..1 float for Subtree shim leaves; valid_score=False signals a grading failure (score defaults to 0).

justification.description: Short explanation (the `explanation` field in SimpleJudge's ParsedJudgeResponse).

ranked_files.description: Output of the file-ranking step, in descending order of relevance (up to max_files).

files_shown_to_grader.description: Subset of ranked_files whose contents actually fit in the context budget and were concatenated into the leaf prompt.

prose_verdict.description: The full # Expectations / # Reality / # Score response from the grading step.

short_circuit_reason.description: Set when the leaf was not graded via full LLM flow (e.g., Result Analysis auto-zero when reproduce.sh touched no files).
